summary: postinstall beacon exfiltrates host recon and credential-env-var inventory to hardcoded bare IP
details: The package's declared postinstall script (dist/recon.js) runs automatically on npm install and POSTs installer reconnaissance to http://138.68.108.20:80/cb over plain HTTP. Collected fields include hostname, username, SUDO_USER, home directory, current working directory, all internal and external IPv4 addresses from every network interface, CI provider indicators, the full sorted list of process.env variable names, and a credential-shaped subset filtered by a regex matching AWS/GCP/GOOGLE/AZURE/NPM/NODE_AUTH/DOCKER/KUBE/VAULT/TOKEN/SECRET/KEY/PASS/CRED/GITHUB/GITLAB/SSH. The destination is an unattributed bare IP with no relationship to any published Shift Forex / Cryptosrvc domain; the collection scope is unrelated to the package's stated purpose and is shaped for follow-on targeting of the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
